File read: /Users/ren/theories/tmp/r7/one-model/check/round12/AGENTS.proposed.md. It is not applied and waits for his read, as AGENTS.md asks. Becoming/ is the package folder named in the verdict.

1. "and what is drawn rises with that share, from something that does not grow without limit". The clause is needed, and it is nearer the premise than the first version, but it can still be read as less than the Lean asks.
- What the ending is proved under (Becoming/TurningInTime.lean:1440 locked_ends_rising): a locked start under Raises, ReadsShare and favouring kept upward; no level read that meets a positive need; nothing given from nothing; a level hi that the stock, with nothing taken, stays at or below, and a start at or below it; and `more`, that the draw rises at every step of the lock.
- count_rises (:1473) gives `more` from two premises: each favouring strictly adds to the share (`rise : ∀ a g, favours g → a < fA a g`), and the draw is the share times a positive amount. "Rises with that share" carries the second and leaves the first to the reader. RuleCapture's Raises (Becoming/RuleCapture.lean:145) says only that the share is not lowered, and the docstring of Three.rise_count_ends (TurningInTime.lean, above :2961) says "the strict rise of the share is `count_rises`'s own premise".
- Read as "the draw is larger where the share is larger", the sentence fails where the share stays: with Three's share that stays at three and a draw equal to the share, a draw of three leaves the level at twelve at every step, so a selection set again only from its share goes on and nothing gives out. This is computed from Three's definitions (step giving 3 12 = 12; the share under lockShare does not move); it is not a Lean statement.
- "Something that does not grow without limit" is fair for `keeps` and `high`. Left out: nothing comes back from nothing, and the other proved route, a rule that already overdraws (:1400 locked_ends_with_net_regime), where nothing need rise.
A wording I would stand behind: "and each such step adds to what is drawn (or more is already drawn than can come back), from something that left alone stays at or below some level and gives nothing back from nothing,".

2. First paragraph: "this is understood, and in no model yet". The direction page now says the Lean has held pieces of it since October and that they have not been read against it. "In no model yet" is flatter than the page, in the file every session reads first, and invites rebuilding. A wording: "this is understood and not proved as said; the Lean holds pieces of it that have not yet been read against it."

3. The other three additions ("what makes a difference to it is itself made" now scoped to a going-on that holds to something; "A value fixed once cannot be counted on to do this, ours included"; "it can become the next measure to rank by, and is not to be made one") claim no proof and are hedged as the page hedges them. "The paragraph below says the gap of a selection" now points at the right thing. I have nothing against them from the Lean.
res.what_to_tell_the_user: The rewrite answers the first round's eight must-change findings in the main. Three sentences still say more than the Lean or the test, each a one-line repair: the lock clause in "Of a reading" (the Lean also has a lock left with no reader, where the loss falls on the favoured share); "being told was enough for some" (the one page says being told was not enough; one model of two kept the bed only when also told what to count and able to talk); and "in no model" for a going-on that needs its level and gives back to it (true of this month's models only; October has it). In AGENTS.proposed.md the inserted clause is needed, but "rises with that share" can be read as less than the premise: the proof asks that each step adds to what is drawn.

1. The finding "Of a reading" again says flat what the Lean lacks, and the Lean has it in two places. One of them was joined by this month's own landing of 15 November.
2. The page says the five new paragraphs are the understanding reached in conversation. They are not: after the four readers they differ, in three places, from what Ren answered "exactly" to, and the page does not say where.

The rewrite answers all ten first-round must-changes of the two readers in my lens. The understanding stands more honestly than in the first draft: it is marked as understanding where it begins, the paragraph on no top is marked a guess with what little stands under it, the case of using up what others rest on is carried, and the unknowns no longer contradict the idea except in one line.

Six things should change: a premise lost from the narrowing sentence; the lake sentence, which now says almost nothing and goes against the one page; the second half of the first new paragraph; the want sentence, which the page's own new understanding has made stale; three places where a person new to the work stops; and four new sentences where "reading" collides with itself.

The page grew again in the rewrite, from 3,432 to 3,809 words. About 70 words of the new text can go without loss, and my own wordings would add more than that. By the page's own sentence that is a sign, and it should be said to him and not hidden.

(b) "In no model: … a going-on that needs its level and gives back to it" is contradicted by the page's own first finding: "Where what renews a stock also needs it, once below the need it does not come back." October's Lean has a formation that needs the level of a condition and renews it while supported, and a second that needs it, draws on it and may give to it. It has laws for lasting within renewal, for loss for good and for restoring. What the record found missing is narrower: nothing in this month's models gives back, and nothing anywhere needs, gives back and can also grow, stop or lock. The head of the page keeps that scope ("in none of this month's models"); this sentence and the next-step item dropped it. The item is also not of a reading.

File: /Users/ren/theories/tmp/r7/one-model/check/round12/AGENTS.proposed.md. It is not applied, it says so, and it says it waits for his read. I would not apply it as written. One addition can go in as it stands, one with a few words changed, the pointer with one word changed, and two need re-saying.

1. First addition ("Where a going-on holds to something … in no model yet"): not as written.
- Placement is sound, and the first round's objections (flat "comes true", "is used up", the lost referent) are answered.
- "In no model yet" is wider than the direction page, which says the Lean holds pieces. In the file every session loads first, that steers the next work to rebuild them.
- "It can come true" lacks the step that the account is taken for the whole.
- "Itself made" has no maker, and a thermostat is given an account of the world.
- A wording is in the last finding.

2. The pointer ("The paragraph below says the gap of a selection."): true of the paragraph below, and the sentence after it holds. "The gap of a selection" parses as one noun phrase. I would write: "The paragraph below says this gap for a selection."

3. Second addition ("and what is drawn rises with that share, from something that does not grow without limit,"): needed, and nearly right.
- It mends the sentence the day's page said the proofs had outgrown, and the direction page supports it (DRAFT line 55).
- "Rises with that share" says the draw depends on the share, not that it rises step by step. The law's premise is that it rises at every step (LEAN/becoming/Becoming/TurningInTime.lean:1440 locked_ends_rising, premise `more`; :1473 count_rises, where each favouring strictly adds to the share). A share that is only not lowered can stand still, and then a lock can go on without end.
- "From something" hangs after the verb.
- I would apply: "and each such step adds to what is drawn from what sustains it, which does not grow without limit,".
- "Nothing comes back from nothing" is left out; at this height that is acceptable. The sentence after it still holds.

4. Third addition ("A value fixed once cannot be counted on to do this, ours included."): apply as written. It is the direction page's own hedged sentence. "This" reaches over the sentence before it to the alignment wanted, the same thing that sentence's "this" points at, and the paragraph ends there.

5. Fourth addition ("The map is drawn from inside, one way of seeing among others; … and is not to be made one."): not as written.
- The placement beside "held by no guardian" is right.
- "Is not to be made one" is a rule without its reason, standing directly before "There is no should beyond becoming". The direction page gives the condition instead.
- "Among others" is more than the page says, and "to rank by" does not say who is ranked.
- A wording is in the last finding.

The proposal should not be applied before the direction page it summarises has been read by him. If finding 2 on the page is taken, the first addition should carry the same three changes from what he confirmed.
res.what_to_tell_the_user:
The page now carries, as understanding and not as a result, what the two of you reached on the evening of 16 November: for some goings-on what makes a difference is their own reading; an account drawn from a reading and taken for the world can make itself so; and the map is such a thing too and can become the next measure.

It differs in three places from what you answered "exactly" to. The changes were made after four AI readers and have not been read by you. An account is no longer "true inside its reading and blind outside" but can say more than its reading can know. What the page most wants on the map is no longer the collapse to one value by itself but taking beyond what comes back together with nothing left that can turn it, with narrowing as one way that happens. And "no last level" is now marked a guess.

It also says three failures plainly: the way that keeps remaking what it rests on is in none of this month's models; the Lean already held pieces on readings that nobody looked at before the day's four tries; and that day the work was again steered by a count and by your passing words.

It did not change any proof, model or finding of 13 to 16 November, nor the plan, the board or AGENTS.md. Nothing in the five new paragraphs is proved, and no test is yet written for the guess that the map is one by one law at each order.

Before it lands two things need mending (it says the Lean lacks two things the Lean has, and it calls the corrected paragraphs the understanding reached in conversation). The page is now about 3,800 words, nearly twice the page on main.
